 8 die, 1,674 hospitalised with dengue in 24 hours
 Six deaths reported in Dhaka division; total fatalities rise to 491 
 Published : 14 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 14 November 2026, 18:13
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least eight people died of dengue and 1,674 others were hospitalised across the country in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the latest fatalities, six were reported in Dhaka division, while Chattogram and Rajshahi divisions recorded one death each.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest figures, the country's dengue death toll has risen to 491, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 160,557.
 Currently, 5,915 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
